description: IWR1843 SAR/LVDS raw-ADC firmware (firmware_dev iwr1843_sar_lvds): MSS-only, no TLV/data UART, CBUFF ADC over LVDS (dataFmt 0/1/2/4). Saved system JSONs use the driver board IWR1843_SAR (driver_board).

lvds_data_fmts.source: firmware_dev/projects/iwr1843_sar_lvds/src/mss/mmw_cli.c:626-631 (0 off, 1 ADC, 2 ADC + SAR metadata, 4 CP_ADC_CQ)

n_tx.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 1: DS Table; max 2 simultaneous per chirp (SYS_18xx, RL:925)

band_subranges_ghz.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 3: a sweep must lie wholly inside one sub-band (RL:667-668)

max_slope_mhz_us.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 4: datasheet ramp rate (DS14 5.7 / DS18 7.7 / DS68 7.9); RL:710,713

max_sample_rate_ksps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 5: complex-1x, regular ADC mode (RL:742-757; IWR1843 12500 per datasheet IF 10 MHz, user ruling 2026-10-06); firmware_dev/projects/iwr1843_sar_lvds/docs/sar_cfg_guide.md section 4 / sar_cfg_check.py allow 18750 (generic xWR1xxx header text), a firmware-docs discrepancy flagged in the memo

lowpower_max_ksps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits (correction section; rl_sensor.h L742-767): applies only when the cfg selects low-power ADC mode (lowPower <x> 1); API doc, not datasheet

min_chirp_cycle_us.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 7: chirp cycle (idle + rampEnd) minimum, RL:651-654, RL:4570-4573; +10 us if the watchdog is on (xWR1xxx), not modelled

min_frame_blank_us.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 16: inter-frame blank typically >= 300 us (+150 us if the profile changes); RL:978-987

adc_buffer_bytes.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 9: ADC buffer 32 KB, profile max (SYS18:306, RL:728)

adc_buffer_streaming_bytes.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 9: ping/pong halves, usable per chirp when streaming (inferred, same as SAR, firmware_dev/projects/iwr1843_sar_lvds/docs/sar_cfg_guide.md section 4 Timing math and limits)

lvds_lane_mbps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#single-chip-limits row 12: DCA1000 max and demo/SAR program 0x9 = 600 (silicon allows 900)

channel_cfg_args.source: shipped single-chip cfgs: channelCfg rx tx cascading

hpf1_corner_khz.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E1: swrs228b s7.7 RF Specification fn (3) p.28-29; mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t hpfCornerFreq1 (index = code)

hpf2_corner_khz.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E1: swrs228b s7.7 RF Specification fn (3) p.28-29; mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t hpfCornerFreq2 (index = code)

rx_gain_min_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: swrs228b s7.7 RF Specification (max 48, range 24, step 2); applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_max_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: swrs228b s7.7 RF Specification (max 48, range 24, step 2); applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_step_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E2/E3: mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t rxGain 'all even values'; datasheet 'Gain step size 2 dB'

rx_gain_rf_target_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t rxGain b7:6 (xWR1xxx table); index = rxGain bits 7:6, bits 7:6 are preserved on write-back

if_band_frac_complex1x.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_complex2x.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_real.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

complex1x_upper_half_is_positive_if.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: ar_baseband_appnote s3.1.2 Fig.5 (one-sided complex-1x spectrum 0..fs; a 2015 AR1243/1642 note, shared DFE assumed)

mimo.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#chirp-patterns (c1ccf7a) section 2: same SDK 3.6 parser, frame mode only, no BPM evidence (conservative false)

IWR1843.flash_hint: ./fw flash iwr1843_sar_lvds <cli port> (docs/firmware.md Commands: SOP 101, flash, SOP 001, power-cycle)
IWR1843.note: source-derived: version same as the demo (mmw_cli.c:761 overridePlatformString xWR18xx); sarStats answers Done on the SAR image only (mmw_cli.c:804) and the reply must end in the SAR prompt mm_sar_lvds:/> (the old SAR image prints mmwDemo:/> and is refused); bench-recorded 2026-10-10 (fw verify pass, capture ACCEPTED, current SAR image sha256 a06ee615...)

detection_note: The SAR firmware has no on-chip detection: the build removes the CFAR chain and the demo CLI refuses cfarCfg / cfarFovCfg.
